Framed in elegance, everything looks precious and beautiful — like locking into a beautiful environment, a room staged like a kingdom. The stage frame is now the universal pattern: everything morphs into the stage / frame concept, all pages operate within it, including the Dashboard — stats framed read nicer and are easier to understand. The one exception: the smart feeds in the Hub stay as they are. His screenshots of the different frame styles are the reference set for the team.
